name: Feast at the Blue Recluse
summary: Your work for Morgan Stern in Dustwallow Marsh, ending with ... and Bugs, leads you back to Angus Stern at the Blue Recluse.

sections.title: Back to the Blue Recluse
sections.body: Angus Stern is the uncle of Morgan Stern, whose recipe research you helped with in Dustwallow Marsh. Your road now leads back to Angus at the Blue Recluse.

sections.title: What Angus Has Heard
sections.body: Angus has heard from the nephew that you aided his research, and that you helped one of his associates out of a tight spot. The Sterns look after their own friends, and a party in your honor is about to begin.

faq.answer: Angus Stern is the uncle of Morgan Stern, who gathers recipes in Theramore, and is connected to the Blue Recluse.

faq.q: How is Angus Stern connected to Morgan Stern?
faq.answer: Angus is Morgan's uncle. Angus sent Morgan to Theramore to gather recipes for the Blue Recluse's new bayou-themed menu.
It follows ... and Bugs, the last of the work you did for Morgan Stern in Theramore.
